title: The Hidden Things in the Eye and Senses
description: Two paired teachings on the senses as a populated cosmic battlefield. (T95) Two hundred thousand seals in the body met by twenty myriads of archons of Darkness; the chosen are purified and gathered inward through voice, speech, and stillness, while archons are driven outward into Error. (T96) The eye as microcosm with four visible types and a hidden fifth; the riddle of the pupil seeing by day but not by night signifies the gate between upper and lower place through which the First Man descends.
